set: A: the keys `step2-rest` and `step2-dial`, whole and in native crops, and the sheet `machines`, each beside the approved image

issues.where: the Continue button, lower right (also set-A-02-b, set-A-03-b, set-A-04-b crops)
issues.what: it is a dark slate glossy pill with bright bold white text, so it reads as an active button; the target's is a pale, translucent, frosted grey pill with faint low-contrast text, clearly disabled and sunk into the page
issues.fix: lighten the pill to the pale frosted grey of -a, drop the gloss and the dark rim, fade the label to a light grey close to the pill, and seat it low on the page with only a soft short shadow

issues.where: the whole page surface (all b files)
issues.what: the page is a cooler, darker grey with a coarse pebbled, embossed grain; the target is a brighter warm cream paper with a fine, flat fibre grain
issues.fix: raise the page brightness and warm it toward cream, and replace the pebble texture with a fine, low-relief paper fibre grain

issues.where: the three fields, right column (also set-A-02-b, set-A-03-b, set-A-04-b)
issues.what: the fields are flat neutral grey wells with a thin bright rim; the target's are glass with a cool green-grey tint, a soft inner top shadow and a lit lower lip that reads as a thick pane set into the page
issues.fix: tint the field fill cool green-grey, add the soft inner shadow under the top edge and a soft bright glass lip along the bottom, and soften the hard light outline

issues.what: the arrow has a thin grey outline and an off-white, shaded fill with a broad blurred shadow; the target's arrow has a crisp, heavy near-black outline, a clean white fill and a tight shadow to the lower right
issues.fix: thicken the outline and darken it to near black, make the fill flat clean white, and tighten the shadow to a short soft offset down-right

issues.where: the progress row, top right (all b files)
issues.what: the round buttons are polished mirror chrome with a hard white rim highlight and the rail is a dark grooved bar; the target's buttons are satin brushed steel with engraved-looking numerals, the rail is a light satin steel rod, and the orange button is a taller satin puck
issues.fix: move the buttons from chrome to satin brushed steel with softer highlights, lighten the rail to a pale satin rod, and give the orange button a straighter, taller side with a satin, less glossy finish

issues.where: shadows of the raised parts: orange progress button, dial, cranks (all b files)
issues.what: shadows are short and close; in the target the key light from the upper left throws long, soft shadows down and to the right (the orange step button, the dial, and the crank knobs all trail a long soft shadow across the page)
issues.fix: lengthen the cast shadows down-right and soften their ends, keeping them a light-to-mid grey

issues.where: the rotary dial in the tray (also set-A-03-b)
issues.what: the dial is dark, high-contrast chrome with concentric ridges and sits flat in the tray; the target's dial is bright satin brushed aluminium with soft highlights and casts a long soft shadow down-right out over the tray rim
issues.fix: lighten the dial to satin brushed aluminium, reduce the ring contrast, and add the long soft cast shadow toward the lower right

issues.where: the orange centre button of the dial and the orange step button
issues.what: both are glossy, domed red-orange spheres with a hard specular spot; the target's are satin, brighter orange pucks with flatter tops and a soft highlight
issues.fix: shift the orange slightly brighter and less red, flatten the dome, and cut the gloss to a soft satin sheen

issues.what: the centre is a brushed metal disc with a glossy dome button and the finger stop is a rod; the target has a flat cream inner disc in a metal ring around a satin orange button, a wedge-shaped finger stop at the lower right, and a lighter, flatter satin aluminium body
issues.fix: replace the centre with the cream inner disc and metal ring, make the finger stop a wedge, and move the body from chrome to satin aluminium

issues.what: the window is shallow with flat cream drums and mid-weight numerals; the target has a deep, dark-glassed window in a thick steel frame, rounded drums shaded top and bottom like cylinders, and heavy black condensed numerals
issues.fix: deepen the window and darken its glass, shade the drums as cylinders, and make the numerals heavier, blacker and condensed

issues.where: the date counter's crank, right of the counter
issues.what: the crank is short and its orange knob stops near the counter's bottom edge; in the target it is a long bent steel arm hanging well below the counter to an orange ball, with a long soft shadow
issues.fix: lengthen the crank arm downward with the bend of -a and add its long cast shadow down-right

issues.where: the volume crank and its light bars, right
issues.what: the orange handle is oversized and bulbous and the lit bars throw a large orange halo; in the target the arm is slimmer, the orange handle is a small neat cylinder, and the lit bars are small glowing pills with only a faint glow
issues.fix: slim the arm, shrink the handle to a small cylinder, and cut the bar glow down to a tight soft glow around each lit pill

issues.what: the orange focus ring is thinner with a tighter glow than the target's wider soft orange halo
issues.fix: widen and soften the orange glow around the focused field slightly

issues.what: helper text is a slightly lighter, greyer tone than the target's darker warm grey
issues.fix: darken the helper and footnote text a little toward the target's warm dark grey
